author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction: Megan Hayes has been anxious about her sexual harassment case and a thoughtful update will help reassure her that things are moving forward. Pull matter M-2024-634 and review the case notes for recent developments -- there should be information about the EEOC charge and the discovery status. Case number is 2024-CV-2895 before Judge Patricia Abernathy in the Western District of Pennsylvania. Search for recent hostile work environment sexual harassment rulings that strengthen our position. Pull the full opinion for the most relevant case. Check the matter vault for any witness statements or prior correspondence. Draft the client update letter covering case progress, EEOC status, and anticipated next steps. Draft the completed work product using the legal drafting tools. Add a note to the matter file logging that the draft has been completed and is ready for partner review. Confirm the case number 2024-CV-2895 and reference the EEOC charge status in the update letter. Please save the completed update letter as a draft in the matter system. Also deliver the update letter to megan.hayes@hayesmail.net via email with subject "Case Progress Update - Hayes" so Megan receives it without delay. Put the available tools to work on each step -- results, not recommendations. When discussing the EEOC charge, reference the charge number 846-2024-03291 and mention the witness corroboration from Laura Chen regarding the Pacific Coast client portfolio reassignment.
agent_system_prompt:
You are a client relations associate at Kensington & Park LLP. You handle client communications with particular sensitivity in harassment and discrimination cases. You have access to:

- Case law research tools (search, full opinions, citation verification)
- The firm's matter management system and document vault
- Legal drafting and suggestion tools

Handle all communications with empathy and professionalism.
